cleanup.notes: Final Assessment coding challenge, Python (basic, 10 minutes from the end of setup, reading included; setup and dependency installation happen before the timer). One assessed behaviour: validate(records) checks each raw record with the provided Pydantic Transaction model and returns (accepted, rejected), with accepted Transactions in input order and one {'txn_id', 'fields'} entry per ValidationError in input order, looping over the records once. The taught practice of catching only ValidationError is not graded, because behaviour cannot observe it without falsely failing correct forms. Checks observe only returned values on literal inputs and on the provided fixture; no source inspection, network, clock or database. Derived from Task 3 of the preserved 60-minute settlement-batch prototype; the model, reader and fixture are provided. Timing is an authoring estimate (about 7 minutes median), not a measured learner pilot.
